title: Setting the Table

readiness.math: matching; one-to-one correspondence; left and right

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Supper is coming soon. Let's set the table for two.

steps.prompt: Each thing has a place on the placemat. Find the shape it fits.
steps.hint: Watch: this one goes here. Can you find the next?

feedback.mismatch: Hmm, that doesn't fit there. Look closely at the shape.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The table is ready. Setting a table is a way of saying, "You are welcome here."

journal_line: I set the table for supper: a napkin, fork, plate, spoon and cup for each place.
unavailable_text: The table is already set for today. Supper will be lovely.
